build: version 1.0, eight D64 images (archive.org d64_Pool_of_Radiance_v1.0_1988_SSI_Disk_1_of_4_Side_A); BOOT prints "POOL OF RADIANCE, VERSION 1.0"

comments.text: Cancels the effect being added when it is of kind A ($2AFD): its kind and the damage ($A4F7) set to 0, as cancel does. The immunities (kinds 107 to 111) use it in event 9.
The effect being added ($2AFD) and the damage ($A4F7) set to 0: nothing lands.

A monster's touch puts timed effect Y on the target: the save byte ($2B36) A, the time's base ($2B33) X, no time per level and no fourth byte; the target is loaded, makes its saving throw (save_roll) and gets the effect (spell_effect). Returns find_entry's answer for kind Y: carry set when the target now holds it.
Carry clear with a chance of A in 100: A is written into the CMP at $A73C, and a roll of 0 to 99 (random_to) below it clears the carry.
The CMP's operand, written by chance.
Kind 1, BLESS (events 10 and 17): the morale figure ($2B67) 5 lower, at least 0, and the d20 one higher (d20_up).
Kind 2, CURSE (events 10 and 17): the morale figure 5 higher and the d20 one lower.
Kind 3 (events 4 and 10): against a target of type 4 ($6BD7, the undead) the damage, the save and the d20 go up by 2 (plus_one twice). No spell gives it.

Kinds 5 and 6 (6 in events 4 and 10): against a target whose $6BA5 is $0A, $0C, $09 or $04 (by_target_kinds), the damage, save and d20 go up by 1, 2, 2 or 3 (by_target_bonus), and the damage's kind becomes 9, fire. DETECT MAGIC's kind 5 is in no event.
kind_by_target's values of the target's $6BA5.
kind_by_target's bonuses for them.

Kinds 8 and 45, PROTECTION FROM EVIL and its 10-foot radius (events 11 and 12): when the combatant in hand's alignment ($6BD8) is one of the three at prot_alignments + 0, the target's armour class gets 2 better at the front and back ($6C0F, $6C10) and its save 2 higher. Kinds 9 and 46, PROTECTION FROM GOOD, look at prot_alignments + 3.
Kinds 9 and 46, PROTECTION FROM GOOD: kind_prot_evil with the good alignments.
The save ($2AFE) 2 higher.

The alignments PROTECTION FROM EVIL guards against, 2, 5 and 9, and PROTECTION FROM GOOD's, 0, 3 and 6. The alignments run 0 to 8 (LAWFUL GOOD to CHAOTIC EVIL): 9 is no alignment, so a CHAOTIC EVIL attacker (8) is not kept off.
PROTECTION FROM GOOD's: LAWFUL GOOD, NEUTRAL GOOD, CHAOTIC GOOD.

Kind 10, RESIST COLD (events 6 and 12), and the end of kind_resist_fire: with Z clear, the damage ($A4F7) halved and the save 3 higher. Kind 10 is called with A = 0 from an event, so the BEQ always returns: RESIST COLD changes nothing.

Kind 11, CHARM PERSON (events 15, 17 and 19, and its end). In an event: the side byte ($6C0C) becomes $C0 (the computer's, charmed) with the old side in bit 5 and the charmer's side, from the effect's fourth byte ($4B80), in bit 0; one already charmed keeps its bits 5 and 6. At the end (A negative): bit 5 goes back to bit 0, with bit 7, the computer's, set. Then the other squares copied (copy_parts), its remembered target forgotten ($A600 bit 7), the morale figure 0 and the sides counted again (count_sides). The byte at $A7DC is a NOP, and $A7E8 ANDs with 0.

Kinds 12 and 38, ENLARGE and the strength effects, at their end: the fourth byte, bit 7 off, is the strength to put back: 101 and up is the strength plus 100 with no percentage, below that a percentage at strength 18. Then the strength index and combat figures again, and the character stored. It starts with six NOPs.
Kinds 13 and 14, REDUCE and FRIENDS, at their end: the fourth byte, bit 7 off, becomes the charisma ($6B19). No spell adds kind 13 in combat, and FRIENDS has no combat record.
store_character, the end of kind_charisma.

Kinds 4, 7, 15, 34, 43, 44, 50, 57 and 62 at their end: the effect is put back ($4900 = the kind in $6E6E) with the time $41, a long time that combat does not age. CAUSE DISEASE's kind 34 is one: a disease that never wears off.

Kinds 16 and 17, SHIELD (events 6, 11 and 12): an armour class figure ($6C0F) below $39 is raised to it, armour class 3; when the spell in hand is MAGIC MISSILE (spell 15) it is cancelled; the save 1 higher. The wand's missiles (item power 65) are not spell 15.
Kinds 18, 19 and 20, RESIST FIRE (events 6 and 12): when the damage's kind has bit 0 (fire), the damage is halved and the save 3 higher (kind_resist_cold).
Kind 21, SILENCE (event 15, its holder's turn): IS SILENCED (message $26) and its pending spell marked lost ($A440 = $81).
report_msg X, then the pending spell of party position $6DB4 marked lost ($81).

Kinds 22 and 32, SLOW POISON and ANIMATE DEAD, at their end when the effect's fourth byte has bit 7 set: kind $37 (the poison) taken off, then the holder dies ($83) with IS KILLED (message $2E). The two spells leave the caster's level in that byte (spell_area), so in combat this does not run for them.

Kind 23, SPIRITUAL HAMMER (event 19, the end of a round, and its end; A in $2B01). When the readied weapon is the hammer (type $14 with $F3 as its fourth byte): at the end it is taken away; otherwise it stays. When it is not readied, at the end of a round, and an item slot is empty ($6DE9), a new one is made there from spell_hammer_item, with GAINS AN ITEM (message $10).
SPIRITUAL HAMMER's item, sixteen bytes: type $14, its name's words $00, $14 and $F3, plus 1, readied (byte 6, $80), bytes 14 and 15 $17 and $89.

Kinds 24 and 25, INVISIBILITY (events 1 and 16): unless the combatant in hand has DETECT INVISIBILITY (kind $18, has_effect), the target cannot be picked and the attack's d20 is 4 lower (unseen). Kind 24 is DETECT INVISIBILITY's own and is in no event.
Kind 71, item power 63's (events 1 and 16): $2B17 = $FF, so the target cannot be picked, and the d20 and save 4 lower (minus_4). DETECT INVISIBILITY does not help against it.

Kinds 26, 27 and 28, MIRROR IMAGE (events 5 and 6): with n images left (the fourth byte), one chance in n + 1 that the attack finds the caster; otherwise, unless a square was aimed at ($2B51), LOST AN IMAGE (message $30), the damage cancelled, and one image fewer; with none left the effect ends.
Kind 29, RAY OF ENFEEBLEMENT (event 4, its holder's damage): the damage ($A4F7) less a quarter of it.

Kind 30, the nauseous of STINKING CLOUD (events 11 and 15). On its holder's turn: IS NAUSEOUS (message $0D) and its spell lost. When it is attacked: the attacker uses its rear armour class ($2B58 = 1) and its armour class is 2 worse.
Kind 33, CAUSE BLINDNESS (events 10, 11 and 12): the d20 and save 4 lower (minus_4) and the armour class 4 worse.
Kind 36, BESTOW CURSE (events 10 and 12): the d20 ($2B10) and the save ($2AFE) 4 lower. Called as minus_4 by others.
Kind 37, BLINK (events 1 and 16): while the target has initiative left this round ($A380), it cannot be targeted and the attack misses (d20 $FF).

Kind 39, HASTE (event 18): the attacks or movement in hand ($2B19) doubled. The first time for each effect (bit 4 of its fourth byte, then set) the age ($6B74/$6B75) goes up one, with AGES (message $0E).

Kinds 40 and 41, PROTECTION FROM NORMAL MISSILES (event 5): an attacker's readied weapon (weapon_and_target) with no magical plus ($6D80) and a range of 2 or more is turned away every time (dodge with 100).
Kind 42, SLOW (event 18): the attacks or movement in hand halved.
Kinds 47 and 48 (no event): the damage ($A4F7), the save and the d20 one higher.
Kind 35's start: the save and the d20 one higher.
The d20 one higher.

Kind 49, PRAYER (events 10 and 12, held by nobody, so it counts for everyone): bit 6 of its fourth byte is the caster's side. When that differs from the side of the combatant in hand ($6C0C bit 0) the save and the d20 go up one (save_up); when it is the same they go down one (save_down). So the caster's own side is the one that suffers.
The save and the d20 one lower.
The d20 one lower; CURSE ends here.
Kinds 31, 51, 52 and 53, the helpless, the snake-charmed, the held and the sleeping (event 7): $A4FC = 1 and the turn lost (lose_turn).
Kinds 54, 55 and 58 (58 in event 18): the movement of party position $6DB4 ($A540) 0, and in event 18's movement pass ($2B0D) the value too. Kind 58 holds a combatant a stirge or mantis has hold of.
Kind 59, at its end: kind $62 (98, regeneration) given for good (give_kind).

Kind 61 (events 6 and 12), the power a ring gives when readied (kind_item): fire damage loses one a die twice over (fire_less), and, when it was fire, the save goes up 4 and fire without the magic bit (8) is cancelled.
Kind 63 (event 1): the target is put twice more on the list of what is seen ($9800), where into_targets crosses out an entry listed twice. No monster file gives it.

Kind 64 (event 3, a hit with the second attack routine): IS POISONED (message 5) and a saving throw with save byte A (1 here); one that fails is given the poison for good (kind $37) and dies ($83, IS KILLED). Kinds 65, 66 and 70 come in at $AA1C with easier or harder saves.
Kind 65: the poison with save byte $81, 4 added to the roll.
Kind 66: the poison with save byte $41, 2 added to the roll.
Kind 67 (event 3): a saving throw (save byte 1) against IS PARALYZED (kind $34) for 2d8 rounds, losing the turn.
The paralysis (kind $34, IS PARALYZED, a lost turn) with save byte A for X rounds.
Kind 68 (events 2 and 3): unless the target's race ($6B72) is 2, an elf, paralysis for 63 rounds (save byte 1).
Kind 69 (event 3): paralysis for a d11 plus 9 rounds with save byte $C1, the save 2 harder.
Kind 70: the poison with save byte $C1, the save 2 harder.
Kind 72 (events 8 and 19): 95 times in 100, kind_invisible_round.
Kind 56 (events 8 and 19, the battle's start and each round's end): INVISIBILITY (kind $19) for 1 round, fourth byte $0C (add_effect at $2A97).

Kind 73 (event 2): when the target has been hit twice or more this round ($A4FA), the attacker rakes: two attacks of 2d4 ($6C12, $6C14, $6C16), its first routine's cleared, RAKES (message $39), and the attack made (attack).

Kind 74 (events 13 and 15), the holder's: when it is down the hold ends (let_go); while it holds ($6C1E) its turn is an attack from behind on the one held ($6C1D), one attack of 3d4. Then its attacks ($6C11) are 1 when $A4FF is set, which also ends the hold, and 0 otherwise.
The hold ended: $6C1E = 0, its remembered target ($A680) marked, and the one held ($6C1D) loses kind $3A, the hold.

Kind 75 (events 13 and 15), the stirge's while attached: SUCKS SOME BLOOD (message $13), a d4 taken from the one it holds (no save, kind 0) and from its own count ($6C1C); it lets go when it is down or the count runs out.
Kind 76 (event 2): a hit fastens the stirge on: a count of 11 ($6C1C), attached ($6C1E), the target noted ($6C1D), kind $4B (75) given to the stirge and kind $3A (58, held) to the target.

Kind 77 (event 2): unless it is a swing from behind, a target with strength below 19 IS HELD FAST (message $0A, kind $3A, its movement 0); the attacker gets kind $4A (74), notes it ($6C1D) and has no more attacks this round.

Kinds 78 and 81 (81 in event 8, the battle's start): every head entry on the other side makes a saving throw (save byte $11) against an effect for the battle: below level 4 IS PARALYZED (kind $34), level 4 and 5 IS WEAKENED with kind 2 (CURSE's), level 6 and up nothing.
Kind 79 (events 2 and 3): 2d10 more damage of kind 9 (fire), with no save.
Damage $2B00 of kind A, whole (damage_unsaved), slot 7 kept round it; the record's range ($2B32) 0 first.
Kind 80 (event 2): while $6C1D is positive, a d4 more of kind $10, acid. kind_spit sets $6C1D to $FF when it spits, so after that the bite has no acid.

Kind 83 (event 14, its turn): GAZES... (message $14), kind 127 runs (the mirror, kind_mirror), then the target saves (save byte 5); one that fails has no initiative or movement left and TURNS TO STONE (condition $87, message 6).
Condition A and message X for party position $6DB4: stored, centred, reported, then its picture redrawn ($0DC7) with the target the same entry.
Kind 88 (event 14): half the time the computer casts spell $27 (39, CURE DISEASE, whose combat record is the bolt at $AD6D in SPELLE00) with BREATHES... (message $15). No monster file gives it.

Kind 89 (events 8 and 16), a cloak's power (kind_item) and Tyranithraxus's: at the battle's start (round count 0) $6C1E = 0; afterwards the first attack on it misses (d20 $FF) and sets $6C1E, so later ones do not. The byte at $AC81 is a NOP, never reached.
Kinds 90, 92 and 93: fire damage halved (half_if with A = 1). Kind 93 is in event 6; kind 92 is in event 14, the holder's turn, where there is no damage to halve.
Kind 95, at its end: the holder, unless already down, dies ($83) with GOES DOWN (message $2C).
Kinds 97 and 98 (98 in event 19, each round's end): 3 hit points back, plus the carry the ADC finds, up to the full ($6B76).

Kind 99 (events 8 and 13): once a battle ($6C1C), when it goes down with a dying count ($A6C0) below 6, it GETS BACK UP (message $16) with 6 less the count as hit points, condition $11, and dies for good a d4 rounds later (kind $5F, 95).
Kind 100 (event 13, going down): unless the damage was fire (bit 0) or acid (bit 4), kind $66 (102) for 3d6 rounds.
Kind 101 (events 5, 6 and 19): when it has neither regeneration (kind $62) nor kind $3B, kind $3B (59) for 2 rounds, whose end gives the regeneration.
Kind 102, at its end: full hit points and back up as OK (get_back_up with condition 1); the sides counted again.
Kind 104 (event 5): an attack with a weapon of range 2 or more (a missile) is avoided 55 times in 100.
When the attacker's weapon has a range ($6D9C) of 2 or more, on to avoid.
A in 100 (chance) to avoid the attack: the damage and the hits ($A4FB, $A4FA) cancelled and AVOIDS IT (message $18).
Kind 105 (events 6 and 9): magic resistance, a chance of 50 plus mr_by_level for the caster's level ($2B05) to stop the effect, or, with no effect, magic damage (bit 3). No monster file gives it.
Magic resistance's addition by the caster's level, 0 to 5: 50, 45, 40, 35, 30, 25. Level 6 reads the next byte, $A9, kind_resist_15's LDA: 169 more, and the resistance passes 100.

Kind 106 (events 6 and 9), Tyranithraxus's: magic resistance of 15 plus mr_by_level: 60 at caster level 1 down to 40 at level 5, and 184, always, at level 6, the level a scroll, wand or potion casts at.
Kind 107 (event 9): 90 times in 100, sleep (kind $35) and charm (kind $0B) do not land (no_sleep_charm).
Kind 108 (event 9): sleep and charm do not land.
Kind 110 (event 9): an effect with cold damage (bit 1) cancelled.
Kind 111 (event 9): the poison (kind $37) and paralysis (kind $34) do not land.
Kind 109 (event 9): paralysis (kind $34) does not land.
Kind 112 (events 6 and 9): fire cancelled (bit 0).
Kind 113 (event 6): fire damage less one for each die ($2B0E), but not below one a die. Z clear when it was fire.
Kind 114 (event 6): electricity (bit 2) halved.
The damage halved when the damage's kind has a bit of A.
Kind 118 (event 6): cold (bit 1) halved.
Kind 120 (event 5): an attack with item type $57 or $58 is avoided half the time (avoid with 50).

Kind 121 (event 14, its turn): a quarter of the time, once a battle ($6C1D = $FF), when the target is less than 5 squares away: the turn ends, SPITS ACID (message $24), 8d4 of acid (kind $10), save byte $0E for half.
Kind 124 (event 9): 30 times in 100, sleep and charm do not land.
Kind 125 (event 9): sleep, charm, poison and paralysis do not land.

Kind 127 (run by kind_gaze): the target's items, 15 down to 0: a readied one ($6D82 bit 7) with word $76, MIRROR, among its name's three (bytes 1-3) REFLECTS IT (message $19), and the gaze's target becomes the gazer itself (target_load).
Kinds 128, 129, 130, 133, 134, 136 and 138, items' own powers: when the item is readied ($6D82 bit 7) the kind in its byte 14 ($6D8A) is given to the character, otherwise taken away.
Kind 131, the gauntlets': with A positive, spell $12 (18, READ MAGIC, whose combat record raises strength to 18/00) is cast (load_and_cast); otherwise the strength effect (kind $26) ends.

Kind 132: unless A is negative, or the low nibble of the item's byte 14 is the wearer's alignment ($6BD8), the item comes off ($6D82 bit 7 cleared) and the wearer takes the high nibble of that byte in damage of kind 8, then the window cleared.
Kind 135: a readied item on a wearer with strength below 19 comes off ($6D82 bit 7 cleared), item and character stored, and the message at $46DE shown.
Kind 137: kind_hammer with A = $FF.
